notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Mesmeric Trance by paying {U} and discarding a card.
 The discarded card is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Ranar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Mesmeric Trance ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {U}.
Repeat.
